1.e4 e5 2.f4 exf4 3.Bc4 Qh4+ 4.Kf1 d5 5..strategy: Takes the offered pawn with the bishop, which keeps the e-pawn at home and the bishop on an open diagonal; material is level again. The bishop eyes b7 and f7, but White's king cannot castle, so Black will look to win time against the centralised piece.
